strat: Stack north of Nael, rotate clockwise, fire in-out-in-in

steps.title: After Nael deus Darnus appears
steps.rule: Go to 5m south of the centre.

steps.title: After Iceball resolves
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 4, 4m south of the centre.

steps.title: After Iceball hits you
steps.rule: When ThunderTargets leaves out ShieldHealer] and ThunderTargets leaves out MeleeDpsB], stand near waymark D, 7m south of the centre; when ThunderTargets includes ShieldHealer] and ThunderTargets leaves out MeleeDpsB], go to 7m south-west of the centre; when ThunderTargets leaves out ShieldHealer] and ThunderTargets includes MeleeDpsB], go to 7m south-west of the centre; when ThunderTargets includes ShieldHealer] and ThunderTargets includes MeleeDpsB], stand near waymark D, 12m south of the centre.

steps.title: After Firescorched on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: RavenDiveTarget).

OffTank.rule: When FireTargets leaves out H2 and ThunderTargets leaves out [MeleeDpsB, stand on waymark 4; when FireTargets includes H2 and ThunderTargets includes [MeleeDpsB, stand on waymark D; when FireTargets includes H2 and ThunderTargets leaves out [MeleeDpsB, go to 5m south-west of the centre.
